# Synthetic MFCJ5-derived projection fixture

This NEW immutable MFOP1 fixture was generated by the actual two-owner Rust
integration test `mfcj5_spot_perps_native_values_and_control_only_groups_are_consumed_atomically`
against producer `5479d733f02f1a2777579460154e144babe67b87`. It retains two native trade observations,
spot `@12` and perpetual `BTC`, four actual in-memory application writes and
12 wire intent/invocation/settlement groups. Bootstrap, native callback,
committed handoff, wire settlement, native replay/source comparison and seal
assertions ran before export. Exact counts and cursor pairs are in manifest.json.

Native artifact jobs consume these same portable bytes with `hls live
--shared-feed ... --once`. That proves structural consumer compatibility on the
artifact platform; it does not execute or authenticate the native producer on
that platform. Generation source and retained executable hashes are recorded in
the manifest; original source journal and generation logs remain private audit
evidence. No exchange connection, historical completeness, source freshness,
strategy availability, economic result or loaded-image attestation is claimed.
Feed IDs and acquisition clocks can differ on regeneration. Choose a new folder
for a successor fixture; never replace these bytes in place.
